doc.title: Control Sequence API Technical Specification
doc.snippet: Singleton FMU Adapter manages all FMU instances in-process memory. Per-instance asyncio.Lock for concurrent step serialization. Lazy FMU loading - startup validates files exist, extract on first use.

doc.title: G36 FMU POC Findings

python.package: FMU execution library - read_model_description, extract, FMU2Slave

interface.name: FmuAdapter
interface.signature: class FmuAdapter: def create_instance(self, instance_id: str, sequence_type: str, parameters: ReheatParameters | None = None) -> bool def update_instance(self, instance_id: str, parameters: ReheatParameters) -> bool def step(self, instance_id: str, inputs: ReheatInputs, step_size: float) -> ReheatOutputs def delete_instance(self, instance_id: str) -> bool def get_instance(self, instance_id: str) -> FmuInstance def list_instances(self) -> list[str] def get_active_count(self) -> int

interface.name: FmuInstance
interface.signature: @dataclass class FmuInstance: fmu: FMU2Slave model_description: ModelDescription unzip_dir: str current_time: float lock: asyncio.Lock value_refs: dict[str, int] sequence_type: str

interface.name: FMPy FMU2Slave
interface.signature: fmu.instantiate() fmu.setupExperiment(startTime=0.0) fmu.enterInitializationMode() fmu.exitInitializationMode() fmu.setReal([ref], [value]) fmu.setBoolean([ref], [value]) fmu.setInteger([ref], [value]) fmu.doStep(currentCommunicationPoint, communicationStepSize) fmu.getReal([ref]) -> list[float] fmu.terminate() fmu.freeInstance()

constraints.constraint: Singleton pattern - single adapter manages all FMU instances in-process memory
Per-instance asyncio.Lock - concurrent step calls on same instance serialized, different instances parallel
Lazy FMU loading - startup validates files exist, extract on first use per sequence type
FMU accepts invalid inputs silently - must validate ALL inputs before FMU call
FMU is stateful - instances must be kept alive in memory
No native state persistence - crash recovery starts fresh
Use ReheatInputs (internal Kelvin-validated) not ReheatInputsRequest (API layer)
TDD workflow - write failing test first, implement to pass
Mock external libraries (FMPy) for unit tests

tests.standards: TDD workflow per CLAUDE.md: Write failing test first, implement to make test pass. Tests in apps/control-sequence-api-app/tests/unit/test_fmu_adapter.py.
